lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five horizontal rows extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with clear 2D spacing of 15-20 pixels between nodes in the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal carinae to form a rectilinear grid, with the primary spot centroids localized at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical pixel gradient (high-luminance upper edge, low-luminance shadow lower edge) running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) clustered around the ventral-pectoral junction and trailing the pelvic region.
